full_script: Keep quiet, let me talk to you. A framed certificate on your wall cannot be deposited into an automated teller machine. My mentor taught me that the chronic sickness of the educated elite is carrying a first-class degree while wearing third-class footwear. You spent five years memorizing dead theories, but nobody taught you how to generate fifty naira in commercial profit. Your uncle told you that education is the key to success. But when you reached the golden gate of prosperity, you discovered that market traders had already changed the padlock. Academic prestige without market utility is just an expensive souvenir. The marketplace does not salute your grammar; it salutes your economic value proposition. From the state of theoretical breakdown to the state of commercial breakthrough. Ask me why? Because a degree is paper, but information is what makes a man fly.
